verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents official SDKs across web, mobile, backend with shared identity/event model, auto-instrumentation, local flag evaluation, and a Wizard CLI for install, plus REST/HTTP V2/Experiment APIs and OpenAPI spec for programmatic access, giving AI-native builders a full toolkit to integrate against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality beyond vendor docs, and community feedback specifically calls out integration difficulty and data accuracy issues.
